patch.value: Advertise safe linked-test command replacement after an immutable-command edit refusal

During evidence maintenance, test --update-index --set-json with a command field correctly refused rewriting immutable command/provenance identity, but returned generic Command failed guidance without an executable replacement route. The successful current route is an exact command removal followed by adding the replacement with fresh provenance. Preserve the completed metadata-editing and deterministic replacement implementations and improve this distinct refusal UX.

Refusal exposes a stable code and selector-aware supported replacement recovery; SDK CLI and MCP agree on immutable command/provenance semantics; Executed recovery replaces only the selected command and preserves unrelated tests plus append-only history; Metadata-only edits remain supported and preserve provenance
An agent receiving this refusal can discover and execute a safe command replacement without guessing flags or mutating provenance.
Command changes are correctly refused, but generic recovery omits the supported remove/add route.
